app.title: Flare: report a problem
emergency.strip.note: This is not an emergency line.
compose.title: How can we help?
compose.placeholder: Report an issue in the airport or ask for help...
compose.hint: Write in your own words. You can also dictate: tap the microphone on your keyboard.
compose.contact.toggle: I would like a call back
compose.contact.label: Phone number
compose.contact.note: Only used for this report. Deleted 30 days after it is resolved.
compose.privacy: We never ask for payments, passwords or personal documents.
sending.slow: This can take a few seconds.
answer.label: Automatic answer
answer.disclaimer: Answer generated automatically (AI) from the airport's information. It can be wrong.
answer.notFound: We don't have an answer for this. Send it to airport staff?
bounce.title.NOT_AIRPORT_RELATED: We can only help with the airport.
bounce.NOT_AIRPORT_RELATED: This doesn't seem to be about the airport or your journey. Please describe a problem here or ask a question.
bounce.JOKE_OR_NONSENSE: Please try again in a few words, for example: "I lost a bag in arrivals."
bounce.SPAM_OR_ADVERTISING: This looks like advertising or spam, so it was not sent.
bounce.ABUSIVE: Please describe the problem without offensive language.
bounce.TOO_UNCLEAR: Tell us what is wrong and where, for example: "The lift near the entrance is not working."
confirm.title: Thank you. Your report was sent to airport staff.
confirm.next: Staff will look at it as soon as possible. You don't need to do anything else.
emergency.title: If someone is in danger, call 112 now.
emergency.body: If you can, tell the nearest airport staff member. Your message has also been sent to airport staff.
error.NETWORK: We couldn't send your message. Check your connection and try again.
error.TEXT_TOO_LONG: Your message is too long. Please shorten it.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
